Receipts & Payments Summary — Edit

The Receipts & Payments Summary form is used to configure parameters for the report.

You can set date ranges and select which accounts to include in the summary.

Title

Enter a custom title for the report, or leave blank to use the default title.

Description

Add an optional description or subtitle that will appear under the report title.

Periods

Add one or more periods to compare receipts and payments across different time frames.

Footer

Enter any footer text to appear at the bottom of the report.

Exclude zero balances

Check to exclude accounts with zero net activity from the report.

Show account codes

Check to display account codes alongside account names in the report.
